title: Chief Minister of Delhi meets Prime Minister
body_text:
Chief Minister of Delhi, Smt. Rekha Gupta met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today in New Delhi. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X; “Chief Minister of Delhi, Smt. @gupta_rekha called on Prime Minister @narendramodi. @CMODelhi” Chief Minister of Delhi, Smt. @gupta_rekha called on Prime Minister @narendramodi.
